Optimize `invoice_summary` report performance; begin invoice PDF renderer improvements. Also, per operator, eventually upgrade SQLAlchemy 1.4→2.0 and run March 2025 payroll procedure.

- `ReportContext` already provides account/date filters.
- Staging Redis URL defaults to `redis://cache-eu-1:6379`.

- Repeated per-row currency conversion.
